entries.displayName: Axiom by Elevated AI — MCP server
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server for discovering and purchasing paid machine services, and for preparing non-custodial crypto routes. Returns transactions the caller signs; holds no keys.

which x402 service should I use for this capability

entries.displayName: Axiom by Elevated AI — A2A agent card
entries.description: Axiom is a non-custodial routing layer for autonomous AI agents. It helps agents discover and purchase paid machine services and route crypto transactions based on total cost, reliability, safety, and execution quality.
representativeQueries: which agent can route a payment for me
what agent compares paid API providers

entries.description: OpenAPI 3.1 description of every Axiom endpoint: service quoting and relay, capability routing, and non-custodial crypto quoting and analysis.
representativeQueries: what HTTP API can route an agent payment
openapi spec for x402 payment routing

entries.displayName: Axiom by Elevated AI — agent skill
entries.description: Operational guidance for an agent deciding when and how to use Axiom: routing a purchase, reading a quote, and handling quota or route failures.

skill for paying for an API from an agent

entries.displayName: Axiom by Elevated AI — x402 service descriptor
entries.description: Machine-readable x402 v2 service descriptor: supported networks, schemes, fee policy and the capabilities Axiom exposes.
representativeQueries: which service accepts x402 on Base

entries.displayName: Axiom by Elevated AI — crypto routing (beta)
entries.description: Non-custodial crypto routing for autonomous agents. Axiom compares execution routes, validates transaction safety and total cost, and returns transactions for the agent to sign. Axiom never takes custody and never signs. Execution via LI.FI. Axiom fee 15 bps; provider fees, gas and slippage are disclosed separately. Status: beta.
representativeQueries: how do I compare crypto swap routes
prepare a non-custodial swap I can sign myself
what is the total cost of swapping USDC for ETH on Base
which route gives the best output after fees and gas
route a token swap without giving up custody
